name: @dsh-external/dsh-developer-role-guard
description: Protect every non-OpenAI route from the `developer` role: pi-ai defaults supportsDeveloperRole to true for any endpoint it does not recognize, so a newly added third-party OpenAI-compatible route (ModelScope et al.) sends role:"developer" on the system prompt and gets rejected in streaming mode. This plugin forces that compat switch off for every route that is not a genuine OpenAI endpoint, falling back to the universally accepted `system` role.
